title: Covering and loss-tolerant batch designs guarantee what autonomous campaigns sample in SiGeC semiconductors
description: Code, data and figure scripts for the paper "Covering and loss-tolerant batch designs guarantee what autonomous campaigns sample in SiGeC semiconductors" (Molecular Systems Design & Engineering (RSC)).
